4. 培生词汇妙趣屋
   URL: https://www.meipian.cn/284q3wyz
   Channel: customize
   Published: 1561910400
   Content: 培生是全球领先的教育集团，迄今已有超过170年的历史。它的旗下还拥有我们熟悉的朗文、华尔街英语等知名教育品牌。 培生系列非常非常多，其特点是在编排上句型既有重复又有变化，非常有利于孩子语言的输出。 比如： 通过重复句型，让孩子掌握kitchen、bathroom、garden等词汇。


《培生词汇妙趣屋》，共三辑，每辑32本，适合3~6岁初学英语的儿童。每本封底明确列出该书的核心句型，全书围绕该句型展开，学习目标明确，《培生词汇妙趣屋第一辑》平均每4本讲解一个句型，《培生词汇妙趣屋·第二辑》平均每2本讲解一个句型，《培生词汇妙 趣屋第三辑》平均每本讲解一个句型，全套书一共讲解超过50个幼儿所需掌握的基础句型，近600个幼儿必备认知单词。

全套书囊括颜色、动物、五官、水果蔬菜、食物饮料、室内室外物品、交通工具、职业等类型词汇。

图片多，文字少，有着丰富的画面信息，很容易就从图画猜出对应意思，为孩子创造快乐学习的语言环境，每本书都附有中文译文及重点单词释义，且每本书都有贴心全 面的父母阅读指导，让家长更好地利用这本书，在温馨的亲子共读中发挥本套书最大的价值。让孩子在读有趣的故事的同时，轻松地输入英语语言的学习，在生活中 流畅地说出地道的英文。

Our Mission
American Bookworm
At American Bookworm, we are committed to presenting diversity, fun and learning in books that are both fiction and non-fiction.
Each book is hand-picked by our team and read first before we bring it to our customers. We take extra special care in making sure our range of books will be loved by you, just as much as they are by us.
About American Bookworm
Welcome to American Bookworm, your go-to destination for affordable and brand-new books online! We are a dedicated team of book enthusiasts who are passionate about nurturing the love of reading among everyone.
We offer a wide range of books for readers of all ages, from engaging stories for young children to captivating novels for adults.
Our Story
At American Bookworm, we believe that reading is one of the most important skills anyone can acquire. Not only does it open up a world of imagination and wonder, but it also helps develop language skills, creativity, and empathy.
We believe that everyone deserves the opportunity to discover the joy of reading. That's why we offer affordable prices, fast shipping, and exceptional customer service. We are here to help you find the perfect book and to support you on your journey to becoming a lifelong reader.
